name: Blog-Chat-app
description: Full-stack blog and real-time chat platform built in Express + React (Vite) + TypeScript monorepo. Features session auth, per-reader content gating, Socket.io chat, Zod-validated REST API, Redis-backed sessions, and Docker/Render CI-CD. A portfolio project showcasing production-grade backend architecture.

paragraphs: A MERN blog + chat app. It reimplements every real feature of the legacy app — session auth, posts, likes, threaded comments, search — while fixing five documented authorization holes the original had, and adds genuine upgrades (server-side session auth instead of a client-stored JWT, per-reader content gating, MongoDB-backed full-text search, realtime chat over Socket.io, Google sign-in) the legacy app never had.
